arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Damaging enemies with a Non-{c_important}Basic{/c} Skill cast marks them for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. When a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill first hits a marked enemy, the {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill's damage is echoed to all marked enemies, dealing {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
